newsitem.title: USA: Multimedia Games' MegaMania wins support.
newsitem.headline: Multimedia Games' MegaMania wins support.

text.p: Multimedia Games Inc said on Monday the National Indian Gaming Commission (NIGC) found the company's high-speed video bingo game, MegaMania, complies with commission regulations.

It said the executive committee of the National Indian Gaming Association passed a resolution unanimously supporting NIGC decisions that proxy-play of Class II bingo is allowable under the Indian Gaming Regulatory Act and MegaMania fully complies with regulations.
Multimedia Games is the largest supplier of satellite and telephone linked games for Class II bingo. Some federal and state officials have questioned whether MegaMania is a Class II game.
The National Indian Gaming Association represents 154 Indian Nations.
